source_text: Long-term complications encompass meatal stenosis (narrowing of the urethral opening) in less than 0.1% of neonates, urinary tract adhesions, or phimosis recurrence, with secondary procedure rates declining from 3.62% at five years in 2010 to 2.45% in 2020 due to improved techniques but persisting as a concern in ritual practices. [112]
